# Anurag Khandelwal

Canonical website: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/

Anurag Khandelwal is an Associate Professor of Computer Science at Yale University. His research spans computer systems, distributed systems, networking, security, disaggregated memory, serverless computing, and systems for AI.

## Primary pages

- Profile and news: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/
- Publications: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/publications/
- Research impact and awards: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/impact/
- NOVA Lab: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/group/
- Biography: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/bio/
- CV: https://www.anuragkhandelwal.com/cv/cv.pdf
